name: Heavy
description: Heavy weapons require 10+ STR modifier to wield effortlessly. Otherwise, -4 to all attacks.

name: Super Heavy
description: Heavy weapons require 12+ STR modifier to wield effortlessly. Otherwise, -6 to all attacks.

name: Auto X
description: Allows for Full Auto Attack action.

name: Concealable
description: Gives +2 to conceal any equipment form any search electronic or physical.

name: Vac Suit X
description: Works in space, contains life support. X is the life support x12, so Vac Suit 2 is 24hrs of life support.

name: Zero-G
description: Weapon does not produce any recoil, can be used in <0.1g without any noticeable problems.

name: Complex Reload
description: Requires a complex reload skill to reload weapon in combat.

name: Normal
description: The most common form of NPC encountered. Regular goons. Will have 1-2 special features.

name: Elite
description: Slightly more rare to encounter. They are upgraded goons, police sergeants, or sicarios. Will have between 1-5 features.

name: Legendary
description: Very unique NPC's, usually vital to the story. Represents strong opponents, capable of outstanding feats. Can have any number of unique features attached.

name: Small
description: Targeting Small creatures give a -1 DM to hit

name: Medium
description: Average sized creature

name: Large
description: Targeting Large creatures give a +1 DM to hit

name: Ancient
description: A creation of the Ancients.

name: Walker
description: This creature is a walker, it walks on two legs.

name: Star Port A
description: Full facilities: shipyards, high-end services, naval bases, and interstellar banking.

name: Star Port B
description: Good quality: capable of construction and repair, with solid amenities and regular traffic.

name: Star Port C
description: Routine quality: unrefined fuel, supplies, and unskilled repair; often a frontier waystation.

name: Star Port D
description: Poor quality: little more than a marked landing zone, unrefined fuel, and a radio.

name: No Star Port
description: No facilities whatsoever; land at your own risk with no support.

name: Planet
description: A standard terrestrial world with gravity, atmosphere, and a solid surface.

name: Empty Space
description: Nothing but void; no planet, station, or feature—just coordinates in the black.

name: Space Station
description: An artificial habitat or platform orbiting a body or drifting free.

name: Asteroid
description: A rocky body, often mined, hollowed out, or barely large enough to land on.

name: Rouge Planet
description: A sunless world cast adrift between stars, frozen and lightless.

name: Polluted
description: Contaminated atmosphere, water, or soil; filters and hazard gear required.

name: Acid Rain
description: Corrosive precipitation that eats unprotected hull plating and flesh alike. Requires specialised hull plating and vac suits to withstand the corrosive effect.

name: Stormwracked
description: Wracked by permanent extreme weather; habitation is underground or shielded.

name: Red Zone
description: Interdicted; landing is legally prohibited due to extreme danger, active conflict, deadly plagues, dangerous alien artifacts or imperial edict.

name: Amber Zone
description: Hazardous; caution is advised -- conditions are risky but travel is not outright forbidden.

name: Quarantined
description: Biological or environmental lockdown; no entry or exit permitted under penalty.

name: Unexplored
description: No comprehensive survey exists; star charts may be wrong and the surface is largely unknown.

name: No Gravity
description: Zero-G throughout; freefall conditions require magnetic boots, thrusters, or tethering to navigate.

name: Low Gravity
description: Significantly less than standard; high jumps and fragile structures, with long-term health tolls on residents.

name: Medium Gravity
description: Comfortable standard range; roughly 0.8 to 1.2 G with no special accommodations needed.

name: High Gravity
description: Crushing weight; movement is exhausting, equipment strains, and hearts work overtime just to stand.

name: Independent
description: This system is largely independent from any foreign Empire.

name: Major Power
description: This faction is a major player on the intergalactic scene.

name: Minor Power
description: This faction is a minor power, able to wield local power in the surronding systems.

name: Nomadic
description: No fixed territory; fleets, caravans, or migratory habitats.

name: Common
description: This weapon is increadibly common across the galaxy. Its as though everyone and their mother has one! Ammo can be found anywhere, and nobody bats an eye at your piece of metal.

name: Uncommon
description: A regional specialty or niche design. You won't see one on every street corner, but any serious arms merchant or planetary militia quartermaster knows exactly where to source one if you have the patience.

name: Rare
description: Limited production runs, specialist military contracts, or tech from a collapsed polity. Finding one requires knowing a guy who knows a guy. Ammo is specialized and must be ordered, smuggled, or fabricated to spec.

name: Unique
description: There is exactly one of these in existence. A custom commission, a drunken bet between engineers, or a quirk of history. Owning it makes you a legend; using it in public makes you a target for every collector and thief in the sector.

name: Xeno
description: Manufactured by a non-human species using principles that human engineers barely comprehend. Finding one requires journeying to alien space or dealing with xenotech smugglers. Human-compatible maintenance manuals simply don't exist.

name: Relic
description: Predates the modern interstellar order by centuries or millennia. Found in archaeological digs, noble armories, or the hands of cultists. Irreplaceable, historically priceless, and probably cursed according to at least three universities.

name: Fly
description: This creature has the ability to use its movement for flying.

name: AP X
description: Armour piercing. Reduce the target's armour by X when resolving damage from this attack.

name: Explosive X
description: This weapon delivers an explosive payload. Any target caught within X times 3 meters of the explosion suffers an automatic hit and takes damage equal to X D6.

name: Unreliable
description: This weapon is notorious unreliable! If you roll 2 dice with the same value on them you suffer a jam, requiring a reload action to clear! If your weapon is also Explosive, on a jam the explosive blows up in your face. Your attack does not count!

name: Stun
description: This weapon has a stunning effect on its victim! If you deliever stun damager equal to someones END they are knocked unconsiouce!
